groups.name: Akira
groups.profile: First seen March 2023. One of the most prolific RaaS operations by victim count in 2024–2025; speculated ties to the former Conti group; known for exploiting Cisco ASA/FTD and other VPN vulnerabilities plus compromised credentials; double extortion.
groups.sectors: Agriculture and Food Production, Retail & E-Commerce

groups.name: LockBit5
groups.profile: Current branding generation of the long-running LockBit RaaS (active since 2019); LockBit 5.0 (“ChuongDong”) emerged Sept. 2025 following the Feb. 2024 takedown, introducing cross-platform payloads targeting Windows, Linux and VMware ESXi.

groups.name: Eclipse
groups.profile: First seen 2026-08-11. No established public profile yet (recently listed, smaller leak-site brand).

groups.name: N0n
groups.profile: First seen 2026-09-18. Posts a high volume of anonymized “Company #N” placeholder listings citing pending-exposure deadlines; one such masked posting excluded this run.

groups.name: Orova
groups.profile: First seen 2026-07-07. No established public profile yet (recently listed, smaller leak-site brand).

groups.name: Qilin
groups.profile: First seen 2022-10-08. Large, prolific RaaS (Agenda lineage) active since July 2022; Golang/Rust-based locker; double/triple extortion; broad international targeting.

groups.name: Wallstreet
groups.profile: No established public profile yet (recently listed, smaller leak-site brand).

groups.name: Aurora
groups.profile: First seen 2026-04-29. Leak-site brand associated with a multi-purpose Go-based malware distributed by multiple criminal teams since mid-2022, also sold as an infostealer/botnet under the same name; not confirmed as the same operator throughout.

groups.name: Deadlock
groups.profile: First seen 2026-06-15. No established public profile yet (recently listed, smaller leak-site brand).

groups.name: Emperador
groups.profile: First seen 2026-08-12. Mid-size newer group with diversified international targeting.

groups.name: INC Ransom
groups.profile: First seen 2023-08-09. Prolific RaaS active since mid-2023, systematically targeting healthcare, government, education and manufacturing across North America and Europe.

groups.name: Kairos
groups.profile: First seen late 2024. Data-theft-only extortion group (no encryption), primarily targeting small-to-mid-sized organizations in healthcare, manufacturing and business services.

groups.name: Nightspire
groups.profile: First seen 2025-03-12. Rapidly claimed 250+ victims across retail, manufacturing, healthcare, finance and education; aggressive double extortion with ransom deadlines as short as two days. One masked posting excluded this run.
